reviews.title: Would recommend
reviews.comment: Great power supply, I can barely hear it and the quality of the product and packaging was nice, included cables, combs, and some screws and Velcro strips. My only complaint is that the cables were kind of hard to manage
reviews.author: Cooper Nelson

reviews.title: Built well and has awesome cables.
reviews.comment: The build quality is top notch, has a very nice fit and finish.  Power delivery is excellent and I can confirm it is truly an efficient power supply.  The cables included are fantastic, similar to the ROG Strix units that cost 4x as much. The cons-  the coil wine is at a level I would consider an issue.  You won’t hear it with idle load or with a headset on while gaming, but without headphones and under load you will notice it for sure. But if a little coil wine is the trade off for such a good price than I’ll take it!
reviews.author: Michael
